description: Lists the business cards the person received in swaps at an event (a booth scan or a badge swap, in either direction), newest first, at most 50. Each row has the other person's first name, their company, where and when they met (`metAt`), their LinkedIn link when their card carries one (`linkedin` with `url` and `deepLink`, otherwise null), whether the card has an email or a phone (yes or no; the values are not included), and `note`, a one-line "we met at" sentence for a LinkedIn invitation. The same list also comes as a numbered text block, one line per person with the link. LinkedIn does not let other apps send invitations, so the person opens each link and sends the invitation in LinkedIn. Needs a personal connector token. The event is `eventIdOrSlug` when given, otherwise the person's current event, otherwise every swap they have. It only reads; event_card_save_linkedin keeps the person's own LinkedIn link on their card.

eventIdOrSlug.description: Optional event id, slug or name; else the current event, else every swap.

name: event_card_links
title: My cards with LinkedIn links
